entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Collège Stanislas de Paris, colloquially known as Stan, is a private Catholic school in Paris, situated on Rue Notre-Dame-des-Champs in the 6th arrondissement. It has more than 3,000 students, from preschool to classes préparatoires, and is the largest private school in France. Stanislas is considered one of the most prestigious and elite French schools. The school was ranked 1st from 2019 to 2022 for middle school and 1st in 2019 for high school.
